sloka: अपराधम् कमुद्दिश्य त्यक्ष्यामीष्टमहम् सुतम् ।कौसल्याम् वा सुमित्राम् वा त्यजेयमपि वा श्रियम् ॥२-१२-११॥
transliteration: aparādham kamuddiśya tyakṣyāmīṣṭamaham sutam ।kausalyām vā sumitrām vā tyajeyamapi vā śriyam ॥2-12-11॥

translations.english: I shall give up Kausalya or Sumitra or all my wealth or even my own life but I cannot leave Rama who is devoted to his father.
